Xratu 2.0.0 brings the approved work surface into the extension.

Conversation, Changes, and Activity now share a compact composer with model,
effort, context, plan, and approval controls. Completed tool calls fold into
optional steps. Live calls keep Xratu's icons and animations; Activity keeps
the detailed transcript. User bubbles stay on the right, while their text
direction follows their content. The git footer remains in place.

Changes shows real diffs from shadow checkpoints, with file selection,
reviewed markers, per-file comments, and native editor access. Review requests
add to the draft for inspection before sending. Terminal outcomes report the
actual command and exit code. Background-job controls remain available across
all three surfaces.

The sidebar contains Providers, MCP servers, Marketplace, Skills, Agent files,
Usage, Proxy, and Settings. Each page uses the compact approved layout and
works with its existing extension-host handlers. Connection setup moves into
a keyboard-accessible side panel, subscription sign-in stays compact, Iranian
providers remain visible, and saved connection icons use consistent sizing.
Agent profiles expose real discovery results and loader problems.

Both English and Persian layouts adapt to narrow and wide panels and use VS
Code theme colors. Credentials still live in Secrets storage. Agent loops,
approvals, plan-mode restrictions, and shadow-git checkpoint behavior continue
to run locally in the extension host.
